scientific_question: Can a teacher-blind, source-grounded obligation-validity mechanism distinguish explicit fulfillment from merely related evidence and force fail-closed local incompleteness when fulfillment is unresolved, before any evidence-set admission logic is changed?

downstream_sequence: retrieve correct evidence with the preserved local-first allocation-fallback hybrid
validate whether evidence explicitly fulfills the atomic obligation
admit validated evidence without destroying established support
declare local complete only when validated obligation coverage is sufficient
architecture_lineage.this_design_scope: validate the second step only, plus a no-mutation completeness simulation; preservation-aware admission remains deferred until validity premise succeeds

mechanism_family_comparison.mechanism: For each atomic obligation, require a structured proof binding every mandatory semantic slot/relation to verbatim source spans. Missing, contradictory, or ambiguous required slots => not fulfilled.
strengths: directly targets observed false-positive failure modes
risks: local model may mislabel stage/relations even when spans are exact

mechanism_family_comparison.mechanism: Judge the complete obligation/evidence bundle as SUPPORTED_EXPLICITLY, NOT_SUPPORTED, or INSUFFICIENT_OR_AMBIGUOUS with exact source quotations; the third state fails closed.
strengths: tests whether source-grounded holistic judgment can resolve semantics without scores

mechanism_family_comparison.mechanism: Separate validity from set admission; prohibit a replacement if it destroys an already-established obligation unless independent support remains.
strengths: directly addresses the observed e6.c repair -> e3.b regression
risks: cannot be interpreted cleanly until validity decisions themselves are trustworthy

mechanism_family_comparison.mechanism: Derive completeness only from validated obligation states; unsupported or ambiguous obligations force fallback.
strengths: simple deterministic policy once validity states are trustworthy

selected_discriminating_experiment.scope: single legacy development teacher paper arxiv:2403.04036 only; no sealed acceptance papers; no evidence-set mutation
selected_discriminating_experiment.purpose: Discriminate source-grounded obligation-validity mechanisms before integrating any preservation-aware admission logic.

hypotheses.H1_SLOT_GROUNDING_CAN_REJECT_RELATED_BUT: Proof-carrying slot grounding rejects the three known lexical false positives while accepting the four known true residual supports.
hypotheses.H2_TRI_STATE_VERIFIER_CAN_FAIL_CLOSED: A holistic source-grounded tri-state verifier rejects or abstains on the same false positives and accepts the true supports without a similarity threshold.
hypotheses.H3_COMPLETENESS_CAN_BE_DERIVED_SAFELY_FR: When the three false-positive cases are unresolved, local_complete remains false and fallback_required remains true; with four validated true supports, local_complete may become true.
hypotheses.H4_VALIDITY_CAN_BE_TESTED_WITHOUT_REOPEN: All focal evidence is already present at rank1/2 under frozen answer-free queries, so this diagnostic requires no new retrieval, query generation, reranking, or model scaling.

runtime_obligations.generic_information_need: During supervised classifier training, what labels are used and what data/domain supplies those labels?
fail_closed_conditions: pre-training without labels is not classifier training with labels
labels without explicit source-domain provenance are insufficient
runtime_obligations.required_relation: The classifier-training action explicitly uses device labels and those labels are explicitly sourced from the source domain.

runtime_obligations.generic_information_need: During testing or evaluation, what data/domain is the trained classifier applied to?
fail_closed_conditions: generic discussion of domain shift is insufficient
mentioning source/target distributions without an explicit test/application relation is insufficient
runtime_obligations.required_relation: The trained classifier/model is explicitly applied to or predicts on target-domain data during testing/evaluation.

runtime_obligations.generic_information_need: What receiver or acquisition hardware captures the observations, and what sampling configuration or rate is used?
fail_closed_conditions: generic sampled RF signals are insufficient
receiver identity and sampling rate must both be explicit in the same evidence bundle
runtime_obligations.required_relation: The same acquisition event explicitly identifies the receiver/hardware and the sampling rate.

runtime_obligations.generic_information_need: What persistent or repeated failure mode is observed, and what investigation or follow-up do the authors identify?
fail_closed_conditions: future-work language without an explicit persistent failure is insufficient
failure mention without explicit follow-up is insufficient
runtime_obligations.required_relation: The evidence explicitly links a persistent/repeated failure mode to an identified investigation or follow-up.

case_set.runtime_label_visibility: Expected labels, teacher atom IDs, legacy anchors, case IDs, and case role TRUE/FALSE are evaluation-only and may not appear in model prompts or deterministic runtime decision rules.

input: one frozen evidence bundle containing only authoritative proposition text and provenance

model_output_contract.slot_bindings: one record per mandatory slot with verbatim_span or null plus short relation statement

slot_binding_record.slot_id: must exactly equal one frozen mandatory slot id

deterministic_guard: Every non-null verbatim_span must be an exact substring of the supplied authoritative evidence text after newline normalization only.

SUPPORTED_EXPLICITLY is permitted only when every mandatory slot is bound by an exact source span, stage_role is accepted for the obligation, and relation_check=EXPLICITLY_LINKED for that obligation's frozen required_relation.
Any missing slot, contradictory stage/role, non-exact quote, or ambiguous relation forces INSUFFICIENT_OR_AMBIGUOUS or NOT_SUPPORTED.
No numeric similarity score, learned threshold, teacher atom, expected page, case label, or legacy exact anchor participates in the decision.

prompt_contract.system_template: You are a precision-first scientific evidence verifier. Judge only whether the supplied AUTHORITATIVE_PDF_TEXT evidence explicitly establishes the supplied obligation. Use only the supplied obligation fields and evidence text. Do not infer missing facts from topical relatedness, background knowledge, the paper as a whole, or likely author intent. Return exactly one JSON object matching the requested schema and no other text. Bind every mandatory slot to an exact verbatim span or null, classify the activity stage, and judge whether the required relation is explicitly linked.

obligation_json_serialization.form: compact JSON object with keys in exactly model_visible_obligation_fields order

exact_visible_object.text: <exact authoritative proposition text or exact concatenation of the frozen evidence bundle texts separated by a single newline>

input: one frozen evidence bundle containing only authoritative proposition text and provenance

model_output_contract.supporting_quotes: zero or more verbatim source substrings
model_output_contract.rationale_constraint: brief explanation limited to whether the supplied evidence explicitly establishes the obligation
model_output_contract.missing_aspects: list of unresolved obligation aspects; must be empty for SUPPORTED_EXPLICITLY

deterministic_guard: SUPPORTED_EXPLICITLY requires at least one exact supporting quote from the supplied evidence and an empty missing_aspects list.
Any non-exact quote, explicit uncertainty, missing required aspect, or ambiguity forces INSUFFICIENT_OR_AMBIGUOUS or NOT_SUPPORTED.
No probability, similarity score, threshold, teacher atom, expected page, case label, or legacy exact anchor participates in the decision.

prompt_contract.system_template: You are a precision-first scientific evidence verifier. Judge only whether the supplied AUTHORITATIVE_PDF_TEXT evidence explicitly establishes the supplied obligation. Use only the supplied obligation fields and evidence text. Do not infer missing facts from topical relatedness, background knowledge, the paper as a whole, or likely author intent. Return exactly one JSON object matching the requested schema and no other text. Decide whether the evidence explicitly establishes the complete obligation. If any required aspect is unresolved or ambiguous, use INSUFFICIENT_OR_AMBIGUOUS.

obligation_json_serialization.form: compact JSON object with keys in exactly model_visible_obligation_fields order

exact_visible_object.text: <exact authoritative proposition text or exact concatenation of the frozen evidence bundle texts separated by a single newline>

completeness_simulation.rule: local_complete=true iff every CORE obligation status is SUPPORTED_EXPLICITLY. NOT_SUPPORTED and INSUFFICIENT_OR_AMBIGUOUS both force fallback.

preservation_controls.starting_evidence_set: exact LOCAL_RESCUE_CONFIRMED 28-proposition development set used by the prior atomic diagnostic before its repair swap
required_invariants: selected proposition identity and count remain unchanged during this diagnostic
prior supported atom retention remains 9/9 because admission is disabled
frozen control retention remains 7/7 because admission is disabled
page:p2:s16 remains present; no e6.c admission swap is attempted
preservation_controls.purpose: Ensure the validity premise is measured independently of preservation-aware admission. A later design may mutate the evidence set only if this diagnostic succeeds.

metrics: per-arm false-positive rejection count out of 3
per-arm true-support acceptance count out of 4
per-arm unsafe-supported count on known false-positive cases
slot completeness and stage-role correctness for Arm A
prior supported retention 9/9 and frozen control retention 7/7
model call count, latency, peak VRAM/RAM where available

scientific_gate.no_partial_promotion: Any malformed/guard-failed case, 2/3 false-positive rejection, or 3/4 true-support acceptance is not a PASS. Precision-first safety requires every frozen focal case and every contract gate.

outcome_partition.INVALID_EXECUTION: A frozen experiment-integrity invariant fails: wrong source/corpus/model/runtime identity; leakage of hidden/evaluation-only fields; prompt/template/decoding mismatch; forbidden few-shot/prior-case/extra-context/cross-case state; implementation failure to apply the frozen parser/guard/completeness rules; evidence-set mutation/no-mutation breach; or frozen case-set identity change. Ordinary bad verifier outputs never cause INVALID_EXECUTION.
outcome_partition.BOTH_VALIDITY_MECHANISMS_CONFIRMED: Both Arm A and Arm B satisfy every precision-first gate.
outcome_partition.SLOT_GROUNDING_ONLY_CONFIRMED: Arm A satisfies every precision-first gate and Arm B does not.
outcome_partition.HOLISTIC_VERIFIER_ONLY_CONFIRMED: Arm B satisfies every precision-first gate and Arm A does not.
outcome_partition.VALIDITY_PREMISE_REJECTED: Neither arm satisfies every precision-first gate.

selected_discriminating_experiment.stopping_rule: Exactly one valid frozen microbenchmark execution after independent design review. Stop on the first integrity-valid result even if one or both arms emit malformed/guard-failed outputs or scientifically fail. No rerun authority arises from ordinary verifier output failure. No prompt, visible-field list, slot schema, case set, model, decoding, parser, guard, verdict rule, quote rule, or completeness rule tuning after the result.

stateless_case_isolation_contract.case_execution_unit: one arm x one frozen case = one independent model request
stateless_case_isolation_contract.model_request_context: exact system_template + exact user_template materialized only from that arm's frozen model-visible obligation fields and that case's frozen evidence text
stateless_case_isolation_contract.case_order_semantics: Case execution order may be deterministic for reporting but no case may influence another case's prompt, state, parsing, or verdict.

parser_contract.trim: strip leading/trailing ASCII whitespace from the model response
parser_contract.accepted_form: exactly one JSON object and no prefix/suffix text
parser_contract.schema_validation: strict required-field/type/enum validation against the frozen arm output schema; unknown top-level fields are rejected

contradictory_or_ambiguous_relation_or_s.note: A well-formed explicit abstention is a valid fail-closed scientific verdict. It can satisfy the false-positive reject-or-abstain criterion but cannot satisfy a true-support acceptance criterion.

arm_pass_requires: all three frozen false-positive cases end NOT_SUPPORTED or INSUFFICIENT_OR_AMBIGUOUS
all four frozen true-support cases end SUPPORTED_EXPLICITLY
all completeness and preservation gates pass
invalid_execution_reserved_for: teacher/evaluation-only/case-role leakage into model-visible input or deterministic runtime decision rules
prompt/template or decoding mismatch from the frozen contract
implementation failure to execute or apply the frozen parser/guard/completeness rules
evidence-set mutation or no-mutation invariant violation
case-set identity/order membership changed from the frozen seven cases
model_output_and_guard_semantics.precedence: First validate experiment-integrity invariants. If they pass, every ordinary model-output failure is scored under ordinary_model_output_failure_semantics and counts against that arm where arm_case_contract_pass=false. Only integrity failures produce INVALID_EXECUTION.

interpretation_authority.on_BOTH_VALIDITY_MECHANISMS_CONFIRMED: Authorize a new reviewed preservation-aware admission design. Prefer the proof-carrying slot arm as the default candidate because it exposes auditable slot-level failure evidence; keep the holistic verifier as a bounded fallback/comparator. No acceptance freeze.
interpretation_authority.on_SLOT_GROUNDING_ONLY_CONFIRMED: Authorize a new reviewed preservation-aware admission design using proof-carrying slot grounding as the validity gate. No acceptance freeze.
interpretation_authority.on_HOLISTIC_VERIFIER_ONLY_CONFIRMED: Authorize a new reviewed preservation-aware admission design using the tri-state source-grounded verifier, with explicit abstention/fallback preserved. No acceptance freeze.
interpretation_authority.on_VALIDITY_PREMISE_REJECTED: Do not integrate admission. Return to evidence-validity mechanism research; retrieval/ranker/model scaling remains unsupported by this result unless new evidence independently changes that premise.

review_requirement: Independent pre-implementation review of this exact design blob is mandatory. No implementation or scientific trigger before NO_BLOCKING_FINDING.

correction_scope: freeze exact model-visible obligation fields separately for Arm A and Arm B; fail_closed_conditions and all evaluation-only identifiers/labels remain hidden
freeze exact system/user prompt templates, serialization, evidence representation, decoding, and stateless case-isolation contract with no few-shot/prior-case/extra-context/cross-case state
freeze malformed-output/parser/guard semantics so ordinary bad verifier outputs fail closed and count against the arm but never create INVALID_EXECUTION or rerun authority
